author: Marlon Chaviano
name: android-compose
title: Android app with Jetpack Compose
description: Google's official architecture template: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Hilt, Room, navigation and tests, following the recommended Android architecture.

base.command: command -v git >/dev/null || exit 1; bash -c '[ "${BASH_VERSINFO[0]}" -ge 4 ]' || { echo 'bash 4+ is required (macOS: brew install bash)' >&2; exit 1; }; git clone --depth 1 -b base https://github.com/android/architecture-templates.git {{name}} && cd {{name}} && rm -rf .git && bash customizer.sh com.example.app Item App

setupTasks: Android: open the project in Android Studio (needs the Android SDK and JDK 17+). Change the `com.example.app` package before publishing.
instructions:
## How to work here

- Follow the template's architecture: UI in Compose with one ViewModel per screen, data in repositories and Room in the data layer, all injected with Hilt.
- UI state is immutable and flows from the ViewModel to the screen (`StateFlow` + `collectAsStateWithLifecycle`).
- Dependency versions go in `gradle/libs.versions.toml`.
- Before finishing: `./gradlew assembleDebug testDebugUnitTest`.
